mechanics.summary: Every Town Center recruits a villager automatically and at no cost every 22 s while villagers are below the villager capacity (10 at start, +10 per Longhouse). Recruitment can be toggled off. Falkr's Village saga cuts the interval by 2 s.
evidence: jeando17:cmvh79tyz009g93qeg2m66zmq (villager_production_manager_vik, always_on, buildingIds: capital and additional Town Center)
checklist:vikings/bonus/Northern Migration#effectText ("Town Centers automatically recruit Villagers at no cost up to the Villager Capacity") [confirmed]
transcript:ehO1BOe7wG8@02:44 ("I'm receiving the villager every 22 seconds for free")
transcript:nd74LibluQ0@19:17 ("TC finishes and instantly produces a villager so auto queue on all your town centers")

mechanics.summary: Longhouse: 150 wood, 30 s, +25 maximum population, +10 villager capacity, trains Bondi 25% slower, one attachment.
evidence: frame BV1EFnH6LEMH_p1@00:34 (HUD villagers 10/20, population 11/35 after one Longhouse)
transcript:ehO1BOe7wG8@08:55 (Bondi at the Longhouse: 23 s = 17 s / 0.75)

mechanics.summary: One attachment per Longhouse. Bee Skeps 200 wood, 20 s: 50 gold per minute, limit 6. Farmstead 200 wood, 2 s: food drop-off and two vegetable fields gathered 50% faster than a farm, limit 6. Smithy and Pasture and Loom 100 wood 100 gold, 20 s, Feudal Age, limit 1 each: auto-research one damage / armor tier per age at no cost (270 s; earlier ages 60 s faster).
evidence: frame:ehO1BOe7wG8@07:44 (overlay "ATTACHMENTS IN DARK AGE: BEE SKEP OR FARMSTEAD")
checklist:vikings/bonus/Bee Skep Production#effectValue = 8 (on screen: 8 gold per 10 s tick)

mechanics.summary: Konungr Hall hosts a feast every 60 s: 10 food plus 5 food per Longhouse.
One-time Konungr Hall ability: 800 food dispatches 1 Shield Maiden plus 1 per Longhouse (ignores the Shield Maiden limit).
Baugr Fort acts as a Barracks (all units and technologies); all Barracks work 25% faster; Barracks technologies cost 15% less; Bondi and Berserkers become Hardened on completion.

Sacred Groves (limit 3; a Völur sacrificed on a Relic, or on a Sacred Site once the Gullínn Temple stands) recruit Berserkers automatically and give +1 melee and ranged armor nearby. The Gullínn Temple acts as a Sacred Grove. Production time: Gullínn Temple 50 s; Sacred Grove 100 s (one source). Dreki saga: 15% faster.
evidence: checklist:vikings/bonus/Sacred Groves / Hamingja#interval = 100 [single-source] (Valdy: "1 minute and 40 seconds and then you get one berserker")

mechanics.summary: Seven sagas. Engine-completable: Falkr's Village (6 Longhouse attachments: villagers recruited 2 s faster, attachments -20% cost); Ulfr's Forester (recruit 25 infantry: +5 torch damage, +1 tile torch range); Jofurr's Hunt (2500 food from Boar, Deer or Shore Fish: villagers gather 10% faster and carry +5); Dreki's Temple (construct the Gullínn Temple: Sacred Groves 15% faster). Combat or trade sagas (Björn, Hrafn, Jörmungandr) are not completed by an engine plan.
With Bondi Forester each Bondi provides 10 wood per minute, at most 250 per minute.
Ríkets Nyckel Castle: unit tier technologies -50% cost; 10 Skåne Crossbowmen on completion; +10 population.
Kongens Dør Cathedral: tithe of 10 gold per Longhouse inside its slowly expanding area every 30 s; +10 population.
Jylland Knights grant 10 gold when killed; Code of Jylland +15; Valdemar Castle +20.
Infantry heal by consuming 1 food every 3 s from a food source (0.4 HP/s, improves per age).
A Völur visiting a Longhouse raises its Bee Skeps / Farmstead production by 15% for a duration.
